overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by posting a meeting notice with a start time nine hours off, found the violation intentional, and ordered compliance and ratification of prior minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Building Committee posted a notice with an inaccurate start time (7:00 P.M.) for a January 9, 2025 meeting that actually began at 10:00 A.M.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law requires that a public body post notice of every meeting in its official notice posting location containing an accurate and clear start time.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Within 30 days, ratify the vote approving the November 7, 2024 meeting minutes at a properly posted future meeting.
Referral for a hearing under 940 CMR 29.07(3), with a recommended $500 civil fine for the intentional violation.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
